title: Refund and Cancellation Policy | Buggy Rents Dubai
description: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your slot, no deposit on standard bookings, and a full refund if we call off a ride for weather. In plain language.
lede: No deposit on a standard slot, so there is usually nothing to refund in the first place. Here is exactly how cancellations, weather calls and no shows work.

ctaPrimary.label: Change my booking
ctaPrimary.message: Hi Buggy Rents! I need to change or cancel a booking.

panel.title: Nothing is due upfront
panel.sub: You pay at the base before you ride. Cancel more than 24 hours out and there is nothing to reclaim.
points: Full refund if we call the ride off for weather

introH2: Why most cancellations cost nothing at all
introLede: The policy is simple because the payment model is simple. No money moves until you are standing at the base.
introBody: {deposit} Because of that, cancelling a standard booking usually involves no money at all. You tell us, we release the slot, and that is the end of it.

The one case where we do ask for something is a no show with no message. If a driver has left for your hotel and a guide is holding machines that nobody else could book, that slot is genuinely gone. Even then, message us. If there is a real reason we would rather move you than charge you.
cardsLede: Almost every cancellation falls into one of these three.

cards.p: Message us any time up to 24 hours before your slot. Nothing is charged and nothing needs refunding, because nothing was paid.
Late changes happen. Our first move is to find you another date rather than charge you. Tell us as early as you can.
If wind, heat or visibility make the route unsafe, we contact you before you travel. Reschedule at no cost, or take everything back.

checksH2: Details that affect what you pay.
checksLede: Worth checking now rather than discovering at the base.

checks.p: A two seater at AED {buggyFrom} is AED {buggyFrom} for the buggy, not per person. Two people riding together halves it each.
{pickup} Outside Dubai we quote the transfer before you commit, so there is no surprise.
Multi vehicle and corporate bookings are confirmed separately and may carry their own terms. We tell you upfront.
{payment} Nothing is taken at booking time.

stepsH2: How to cancel or move a slot
stepsLede: One message does it. There is no form and no account to log into.

steps.p: Reply on the chat you booked in so we can find the slot straight away.
If you want a different date, give us two options and we will check what is open.
You get a message back confirming the slot is released or moved. Keep it.
Because no deposit was taken, a standard cancellation involves no refund process at all.

faqLede: Straight answers, including the cases where you would not get money back.

faqs.q: How late can I cancel for free?
faqs.a: Up to 24 hours before your slot. Because no deposit is taken on a standard booking, there is normally nothing to refund anyway. Just message us so we can release the machine.

faqs.q: What if the weather is bad on the day?
faqs.a: We make that call, not you. If wind, heat or visibility make the route unsafe we contact you before you travel and reschedule at no cost. If no other date works, you get a full refund.

faqs.q: Do I lose anything if I cancel two hours before?
faqs.a: Message us and find out rather than assuming. Our first move is to offer you another date. We only treat it as a lost slot if nobody tells us anything and a driver has already left.

faqs.q: Is a deposit needed to hold a slot?
faqs.a: No, not on standard bookings. Multi vehicle and corporate bookings are confirmed separately and we explain any conditions upfront.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund if I change my mind at the base?
faqs.a: If you have not paid and not ridden, you simply do not pay. If you decide the machine is not for you after the briefing, talk to the guide. We would rather move you to something easier than take money for a ride you did not enjoy.

faqs.q: What if only part of my group turns up?
faqs.a: Tell us as soon as you know. We charge for the machines that go out, so dropping a vehicle before the day costs nothing.
